name: @luraty/pack-ar
description: Modern Standard Arabic language pack for @luraty/engine — 10,000 lemmas ranked from Leipzig newswire, 192,255 surface forms lemmatized against CC0 Wikidata.

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run check:publish
scripts.check:publish: npm run build && publint --strict && node --input-type=module -e "const m = await import('@luraty/pack-ar'); if (m.vocabulary.length === 0) process.exit(1)"
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run check:publish
